title: 重い処理は重くカウント！Workers の Rate Limiting binding に delta が来たよ
summary: Workers の Rate Limiting binding の limit() に省略可能な delta が追加。リクエストごとに消費量を変えて、重い処理ほど多く枠を使わせられるよ！
title_en: Heavy Requests Count More! Workers Rate Limiting Binding Gets delta
summary_en: The Workers Rate Limiting binding's limit() now accepts an optional delta, so expensive operations can consume more of the same rate limit.
og_title: Workers - Count weighted requests with the Rate Limiting binding API in Workers
